title: ihris-site-theme-dark-grounds/v1
description: What a PERSON decides about the ihris site's dark scheme, which the 4.3.3 release cannot answer because it has no dark stylesheet: how dark each ground is, as a lightness on the hue of a measured colour, the WCAG targets, and how the logo is shown. Everything else is derived from it by src/tools/derive_dark_theme.py. A wireframe candidate (status candidate) or the owner's choice (status proposed, then accepted). New because neither folio-assistant's ThemeSchema nor ihris-site-theme/v1 records a person's choice of grounds.

chosenIn.description: The wireframe decision that chose these grounds (repository path).

hueOf.description: A token MEASURED in ihris-site-theme/v1 whose hue (and, unless saturation is given, saturation) the ground takes.
